notice.title: Annuity suitability assessments

text:
INSURANCE CONDUCT OFFICE FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Annuity suitability assessments
Notice number: RCN-2026-016
Issued by: Insurance Conduct Office
Published: 2026-10-27
Effective date: 2027-03-01
1. Who this applies to
Insurers and insurance intermediaries that sell or recommend fixed or variable annuities to consumers.
2. Background
Annuities are long-term commitments with surrender charges. Sellers must make sure an annuity suits the customer before the sale.
3. Requirements
3.1 An insurer or insurance intermediary must complete a written suitability assessment before recommending an annuity to a consumer.
3.2 An insurer must disclose surrender charges and the surrender period before the consumer signs an annuity contract.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-03-01.
